content: संयमनम् .²1 Restraining, checking. .²2 Drawing in; <ls>Ś. 1</ls>. .²3 Binding, tying up; <ls>U. 1</ls>; अलकसंयमनादिव लोचने हरति मे हरिवाहनदिङ्मुखम् <ls>V. 3. 6</ls>. .²4 Confinement. .²5 Self-denial, control. .²6 A religious vow or obligation. .²7 A square of four houses. .{@-नः@} One who restrains or regulates, a ruler. .{@-नी@} <ab>N.</ab> of the city of Yama. सा च संयमनी नूनं सदा सुकृतिनां गतिः <ls>Mb. 7. 72. 44</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 10. 89. 42</ls>; खण्डिताः खड्गधाराभिर्ययुः संयमिनीं पुरीम् <ls>Śiva B. 27. 32</ls>.
